summary: Cook County 80-foot Aermotor ladder lookout built in 1931 near Hovland and removed in summer 2017; the site now lies in a scientific and natural area in Grand Portage State Forest.

facts.status_note: Removed in summer 2017; no tower remains, and the site is forest inside a scientific and natural area

access.note: Site lies inside Grand Portage State Forest, a state forest; no restriction is stated in the sources read

notes_for_editor: Built 1931 and removed summer 2017 agree across the county survey and North Shore Visitor. The site is described as inside a scientific and natural area; North Shore Visitor calls it Spring Beauty Northern Hardwoods SNA while Wikipedia says Spring Beauty Hardwoods SNA, so the story avoids the name. Wikidata gives the elevation as 1,772 ft (540.1 m) but the schema has no elevation key, so it is not used. The octagonal cab and 2007 condition come from one visitor's photo log on kjackson.us and are attributed to it. The brief's access 'unknown' is set to public from the state-forest status. No staffing or fire history appears in the sources read, so none is written. Agency follows the Cook County survey footnote (MFS, now DNR Forestry). No photo added (license not checked).
